metadata.question: Did the surface water width of the Mississippi River near Memphis decrease on September 2023 compared to September 2021?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about surface water width changes in the Mississippi River near Memphis between September 2021 and September 2023. This requires: 1. **Data Strategy**: Use Sentinel-2 or Landsat for water detection via NDWI (Normalized Difference Water Index) 2. **Location**: Need to define a geometry around Memphis, Tennessee along the Mississippi River 3. **Time Periods**: September 2021 vs September 2023 4. **Processing**: Calculate water extent/area using NDWI thresholding I'll use Sentinel-2 MSI data since it has good resolution (10-20m) and appropriate bands for water detection. The logic: - Define Memphis area along Mississippi River - Get September images for both years - Calculate NDWI = (Green - NIR)/(Green + NIR) - Apply threshold (NDWI > 0.0) to identify water - Calculate water area for comparison - Handle cases where data might be missing or insufficient For validation: - Check collection sizes - Check valid pixel counts after masking - Ensure reasonable water area values The answer will be "A: Yes" if 2023 water area < 2021 water area, otherwise "B: No", with appropriate C codes for data issues. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const memphisArea = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[ [-90.3, 35.0], [-89.8, 35.0], [-89.8, 35.3], [-90.3, 35.3], [-90.3, 35.0] ]]); const sept2021 = ['2021-09-01', '2021-09-30']; const sept2023 = ['2023-09-01', '2023-09-30']; // 2. Data Acquisition - Sentinel-2 function getWaterArea(dateRange, year) { let collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(memphisArea) .filterDate(dateRange[0], dateRange[1]) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)); const size = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`${year} Images: ${size}`); if (size === 0) { console.log(`No Sentinel-2 data for ${year}, trying Landsat`); collection = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(memphisArea) .filterDate(dateRange[0], dateRange[1]) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); const landsatSize = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`${year} Landsat Images: ${landsatSize}`); if (landsatSize === 0) return null; // Use median composite for Landsat const image = collection.median(); // Calculate NDWI for Landsat: (Green - SWIR1)/(Green + SWIR1) const ndwi = image.normalizedDifference(['SR_B3', 'SR_B6']); const water = ndwi.gt(0.0); return water; } // Use median composite for Sentinel-2 const image = collection.median(); // Calculate NDWI for Sentinel-2: (B3 - B8)/(B3 + B8) const ndwi = image.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B8']); const water = ndwi.gt(0.0); return water; } // Get water masks for both periods const water2021 = getWaterArea(sept2021, '2021'); const water2023 = getWaterArea(sept2023, '2023'); // Check for empty collections if (!water2021 || !water2023) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Calculate water areas function calculateWaterArea(waterMask, year) { const areaStats = waterMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: memphisArea, scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const pixelCount = areaStats.getInfo()['nd']; if (pixelCount === null || pixelCount === undefined) { console.log(`${year} No valid pixels`); return null; } const areaSqKm = (pixelCount * 100 * 100) / 1e6; // Convert to km² console.log(`${year} Water Pixels: ${pixelCount}, Area: ${areaSqKm.toFixed(2)} km²`); return areaSqKm; } const area2021 = calculateWaterArea(water2021, '2021'); const area2023 = calculateWaterArea(water2023, '2023'); // 4. Validation & Final Answer if (area2021 === null || area2023 === null) { console.log("C2"); } else if (isNaN(area2021) || isNaN(area2023) || area2021 < 0 || area2023 < 0) { console.log("C3"); } else { const change = ((area2023 - area2021) / area2021 * 100).toFixed(1); console.log(`Change: ${change}%`); if (area2023 < area2021) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
